== Summary ==
Original black-border Decipher face for [[Sorry About The Mess]] (A New Hope), preserved from [https://web.archive.org/web/20020328203752im_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/light/images/sorryaboutthemess.gif Decipher.com via the Internet Archive, 28 March 2002].

Deterministic whitespace crop of the 367 by 506 pixel original GIF: x=1, y=1, width=354, height=494. The complete black card, including its border and credits, remains inside a two-source-pixel guard. The retained pixels are identical to the source; no resizing, redrawing, sharpening or text reconstruction was used.

Original GIF SHA-256: d2ea7d92566a289103e9f68b08af280762c17b5a1b18bb6e6c1d123d7f8e4be1.

This is the original printed face, not the later revised face. Do not replace [[:File:ANH-L-sorryaboutthemess.gif]], which is used by [[Sorry About The Mess (Errata)]].
